scope: Read-only proposed-contract review; no source edits, Cargo, QEMU or runtime tests. Storage/reader implementation awaits API freeze.

findings.detail: Fresh open file description per simultaneous reader or writer access lock; Arc<File>/try_clone descriptors refer to same flock and cannot establish per-worker exclusion. Pin same inode; never let one reader unlock writer ownership.
findings.evidence: Local flock(2) /usr/share/man/man2/flock.2.gz and locked rustix1.1.5 fs/fd.rs:317; no dynamic flock experiment performed.

findings.detail: Single file/console worker with blocking stderr can stall true join even without filesystem stall. Never console-write while holding segment access lock; choose nonblocking bounded-loss console or explicitly scope and test actual pipe blocking. Async queue alone is not bounded process exit.

Closed Audit filter must select only typed committed-audit records: exact profile plus permitted unscoped denials by actual actor UID/root admin; no generic processlog exposed by profile string. Auth before cursor/history; Busy/Disabled/Corrupt do not traverse blocked Runtime.

Opaque UUID+offset with complete-line boundary;0matches may still return scan-progress. Header establishes chronology; rotated incomplete final tail preserved and gap reported. Missing lock must not be created by readonly observer. Never reset malformed complete history.

positive_contracts: Postcommit mirror is best-effort operational output, no durable admission ACK or root proof.
Actual USB cleanup before logger join; runtime sink failure distinct from operation/cleanup/WAL errors.
2active+2queued reader lifetime retained beyond timed-out/disconnected RPC; no cancellation claims for actual blocking operations.
Finite payload/segments/queue/page/scan and strict unsafe path/identity rejection.
